name: A shocking native fence wire divides wear between both posts
preconditions: Disposable CodexTest save. Through real player placement and native wire-tool input, place an isolated electricfencepost pair at (-158,44,1107) and (-154,44,1107), wire parent to child, and supply the circuit from the camper battery through a native relay. Verify both posts are below maximum damage and powered. Clear nearby threats; stand near (-156,44,1100), facing north, so spawned enemies approach across this wire. Guard stays on. Check cells and terrain before preparing this fixture; do not use setblock for the native electrical nodes.
